verdict.rationale: There is a public GitHub repository (circlemind-ai/smooth-sdk) for the Smooth CLI/SDK, so some client-side source is likely readable. No license is stated anywhere in the evidence. Community comments asking for self-hosting and waiting for an open-source alternative suggest the core browser-agent service is closed and hosted. Missing for 10: any stated open-source license, evidence that the core service or agent source is published, and independent confirmation of what the repo actually contains.
